templates.name: extract-fields
templates.label: Extract fields
templates.description: Pull a structured set of fields out of free text using the brokered LLM (ctx.llm).
preconditions: A target field schema is provided on `schema`
postconditions: `fields` is an object keyed by the schema fields
Missing fields are null rather than invented

steps.label: Build the prompt
steps.detail: Instruct the model to return ONLY JSON matching the schema; list each field + type.

steps.label: Call the model
steps.detail: Use ctx.llm() with the text; request strict JSON output.

steps.label: Parse + guard
steps.detail: Parse the JSON; coerce types; null out anything not found (never hallucinate).

templates.name: classify
templates.label: Classify
templates.description: Assign the best label from a fixed set to the input text, with a confidence score.
preconditions: A closed label set is on `labels`
postconditions: `label` is one of the provided labels (or an explicit `unknown`)

steps.label: Constrain the choices
steps.detail: Prompt the model to pick exactly one label from the provided set.

steps.label: Call the model
steps.detail: Use ctx.llm(); ask for { label, confidence } as JSON.

steps.label: Validate
steps.detail: Reject any label outside the set; default to unknown with low confidence.

templates.name: summarize
templates.label: Summarize
templates.description: Produce a length- and tone-controlled summary of the input text.
postconditions: `summary` respects the requested max length + tone

steps.label: Set constraints
steps.detail: Encode max_lines + tone into the system instruction.

steps.label: Call the model
steps.detail: Use ctx.llm() with the text and constraints.

steps.label: Trim
steps.detail: Enforce the line cap defensively after the model returns.

templates.name: generate-draft
templates.label: Generate draft
templates.description: Draft content from a short brief in a chosen tone (email, reply, description, …).
postconditions: `draft` is a ready-to-edit first draft in the requested tone

steps.label: Frame the task
steps.detail: Tell the model the audience, purpose, and tone.

steps.label: Call the model
steps.detail: Use ctx.llm() with the brief; keep it editable, not final.

steps.label: Return
steps.detail: Return the draft text for a human to review + send.

templates.name: route-by-intent
templates.label: Route by intent
templates.description: Detect the user's intent from a message and route to one of a fixed set of handlers.
preconditions: A set of candidate intents is on `intents`

steps.label: Describe intents
steps.detail: Give the model a one-line description per candidate intent.

steps.label: Call the model
steps.detail: Use ctx.llm(); ask for { intent, confidence } as JSON.

steps.label: Gate
steps.detail: Below a confidence threshold, route to fallback instead of guessing.

templates.name: redact-pii
templates.label: Redact PII
templates.description: Detect and mask personal data (names, emails, phones, IDs) in free text.
preconditions: The PII kinds to redact are on `kinds`
postconditions: `redacted` replaces each detected span with a typed placeholder
`found` lists what was detected (type + count), never the raw values

steps.label: Specify kinds
steps.detail: Tell the model which PII kinds to look for (email, phone, name, id).

steps.label: Call the model
steps.detail: Use ctx.llm(); ask for spans to mask, not the raw values back.

steps.label: Mask
steps.detail: Replace each span with [REDACTED:<kind>]; tally counts in `found`.

kinds.description: PII kinds: email, phone, name, id
